Dear colleagues,

We are looking for a postdoctoral researcher to join our team in the
Software Engineering section at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU).
The two-year position is part of the VILLUM Experiment project “Is
Correctness Necessary? An Experiment in Test-Free Program Repair.” The
project investigates whether software defects can be repaired using
evidence already present in the code, without relying on conventional tests
or specifications.

The project is broadly related to programming languages, software
engineering, program analysis, and mining software repositories. Applicants
are expected to have a background in programming languages, software
engineering, or a closely related area. Experience with static program
analysis is an advantage.

Location: Odense, Denmark
Preferred starting date: February 1, 2027
Application deadline: November 15, 2026

Details and application:

Please contact us for more information and forward this to anyone who might
be interested.
